Record Class PeriodicTableLayout.Layout

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.PeriodicTableLayout.Layout
Record Components:
width - total layout pixel width
height - total layout pixel height
left - left layout offset coordinate
top - top layout offset coordinate
cellSize - size of an individual element cell in pixels
cells - immutable list of all table element cells
legend - rectangular bounds for the table legend
Enclosing class:
PeriodicTableLayout
public static record PeriodicTableLayout.Layout(int width, int height, float left, float top, float cellSize, List<PeriodicTableLayout.Cell> cells, PeriodicTableLayout.Rect legend) extends Record
Record holding the complete fitted layout metrics and cell listings for the periodic table.
